uninterrupted default-budget native source/replay wins. At deployment the model
rejected the original Cael DamageShield definition under active Full moon.

The original first EndTurn and independent fixed replay capture raw attack22,
health1800,moon mask4; created identity4,moon mask6,and a single fullmoon status.
The complete action,state,forecast,controller and RNG match the native births.
Four parallel branches preserve their parent. A NewMoon query,the Lifesteal

This calibrates the exact original creation signature. It does not add arbitrary
